samples.name: character-rabbit-carried
samples.subject: Brown dead wild hare hanging head DOWN, hind legs together at TOP where hunter holds it; long ears droop downward, small white tail, tan belly.
samples.prompt: Tiny pixel art game sprite for cozy medieval Slavic village, matching supplied Kenney Tiny Town/Tiny Farm sheets. Single inventory-like carried game animal asset on transparent background, no hunter or hands shown. Strict logical 16x16 grid enlarged nearest-neighbor, simple chunky square clusters, flat warm earthy colors maximum 2 shades per material. Centered with one logical pixel free margin, readable at native 16x16. No gradients, texture, antialiasing, scenery, text, borders, ground or shadow. Non-graphic hunted animal, eyes closed, no blood or wounds. Brown dead wild hare hanging head DOWN, hind legs together at TOP where hunter holds it; long ears droop downward, small white tail, tan belly.

samples.name: character-deer-carried
samples.subject: Dead red deer slung horizontally across a hunter's shoulders viewed from FRONT, but do not draw the hunter. Russet body across top/middle, four limp legs hanging on both sides, head drooping at one end with small antlers, white belly and tail. Sized to overlay atop a 16x16 citizen.
